loop: log --- tune an iron handbell to the undead on the Tuning Anvil
assert anvil placed | execute if block 60 -60 60 campanile:tuning_anvil
expectinv took the bell back | campanile:iron_handbell | 1
assert bell is tuned | execute if items entity @a container.* campanile:iron_handbell[campanile:tuning]
log --- ring it at a husk
assert husk weakened | execute if entity @e[type=minecraft:husk,nbt={active_effects:[{id:"minecraft:weakness"}]}]
log --- hang a bell in a Belfry Chime
assert chime placed | execute if block 62 -60 60 campanile:belfry_chime
notes: Tunes an iron handbell with a bone, takes it back tuned, rings it at a husk (undead weakness action), hangs a gold bell in a Belfry Chime and pulses it. Every recipe is checked headless; blocks are placed and kept by the kit. Sound is off in the kit's client.
